name: Robin Douglas
source:
The technicolor-haired Robin lives to race. She's not in it for the running. She loves to win. She's captain of several of Starswirl's student teams. Robin has a long-standing rivalry with Anne. They try to outdo each other at every turn, and it's made them the best of friends. Loyal to a fault, Robin tends to charge in, guns blazing, when her friends are in trouble.

[From [url=http://www.zap-apple.com/p/characters.html]the Starswirl Academy characters page[/url]]
